mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deal_stage_history ( workspace_id, deal_id, stage_id, stage_name, achieved_at, conversion_eligible ) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{dealId}, #{stageId}, #{stageName}, #{achievedAt}, #{conversionEligible})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, deal_id, stage_id, stage_name, achieved_at, conversion_eligible FROM deal_stage_history WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deal_id = #{dealId} AND stage_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY achieved_at ASC, id ASC
